rationale.conceptual: The work uses an established but non-trivial combination of DFT phonon calculations and self-consistent quasiharmonic approximation with analytical formulas (Eqs. 1–4) that require careful implementation. It involves several interacting components and non-trivial physics tracking of mode Grüneisen constants and iterative updating.
rationale.execution: The pipeline spans multiple stages: geometry optimization, energy-volume curves, phonon DFPT at several lattice constants, derivation of Grüneisen constants, then Python post-processing for SC-QHA and thermodynamics. It requires orchestrating Quantum ESPRESSO inputs/outputs, parsing, and scripting, which is moderately complex.

The method is well-established but requires careful handling of multiple components (DFT, DFPT, Grüneisen calculation, iterative solving, and analytical formulas). The pipeline spans several tooling and scripting steps, making it moderately complex. Resource needs are CPU-only, moderate memory, no external data; the paper’s small unit cells keep computational cost manageable for reproduction.
